    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>

</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaApplication" name="Visa application submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BMEIA" name="Austrian representation office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Msg_VisaApplication" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_BMEIA"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision" messageRef="Msg_VisaDecision" sourceRef="Participant_BMEIA" targetRef="Event_AwaitDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria - Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Plan work and living in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Organize accommodation and bank account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Accommodation and bank account arranged"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the general principles and requirements for the issue of visas: application form; travel document valid in Austria, valid at least three months beyond the visa duration, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years; passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm) per the passport photo criteria; fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay (cover of 30,000 Euro, valid in the entire Schengen area); proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the stay and the return journey; other evidence requested by the authorities (e.g. hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment), which may vary by location; absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, Schengen alert).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Requirements_Check" name="All listed requirements fulfilled?"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GatherMissingRequirements" name="Gather missing requirement items">
      <bpmn:documentation>Obtain the listed items that are not yet fulfilled, then check again.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GatherVisaDocuments" name="Gather visa application documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Gather the listed items: visa application form; valid travel document (validity exceeding the visa duration by at least three months, at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years); passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, per the passport photo criteria); fully comprehensive travel health insurance (cover of 30,000 Euro, valid in the entire Schengen area) for the planned stay; proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the stay and the return journey; other requested evidence, which may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" name="Additional documents requested?"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GatherAdditionalDocuments" name="Gather additional documents requested by authorities">
      <bpmn:documentation>Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested. Contact the representation in advance for more information.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Documents_Join" name="Documents complete"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType_Split" name="Visa type?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyTypeD" name="Apply at competent Austrian representation (place of residence, FPG Section 8)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Territorial competence is determined by the place of residence (centre of interest).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCategoryAC" name="Apply at representation of consular district of legal residence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Category A or C visa. Exceptional competence may be claimed with justification. Schengen visas are issued by the representation of the main travel destination; if not determinable, by the member country of first entry.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Join" name="Representation office determined"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Msg_VisaApplication">
      <bpmn:documentation>Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa application sent to the competent representation office.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_AwaitDecision" name="Visa decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_VisaDecision" messageRef="Msg_VisaDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa granted?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaGranted" name="Visa granted, residence in Austria can begin"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Check" targetRef="Task_GatherVisaDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Check" targetRef="Task_GatherMissingRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GatherMissingRequirements" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_GatherVisaDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Task_GatherAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Documents_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_GatherAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Documents_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Documents_Join" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyTypeD">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>visa type is D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCategoryAC">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>visa category is A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ApplyTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCategoryAC" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Event_AwaitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_AwaitDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="Granted" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="End_VisaGranted">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>visa granted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" name="Refused" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="End_VisaRefused">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>visa refused</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Renewal">
      <bpmn:text>Visa renewal every x months (interval not specified in the description).</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Renewal" sourceRef="Annotation_Renewal" targetRef="End_VisaGranted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
